name: auto-board-task
description: Process the top Todo card on a GitHub Project (v2) board end-to-end: pull the board into a task-agent tasks.yml, run task-agent against the top pending task to open a PR, then sync the PR back so the card moves to In Review. Composes `gh-project-sync` → `task-agent` → `gh-project-sync` via the `workflow` skill — all three must be installed.
